newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australia housing industry wants full rate cut.
newsitem.headline: Australia housing industry wants full rate cut.

text.p: Australia's peak real estate industry body on Wednesday urged lenders to pass on the full benefit of the latest cut in official cash rates.
Real Estate Institute of Australia president Don Brindley said the full 0.5 percentage point cut must be passed on to all borrowers for the cut to help boost the business outlook.
"We need quick action to help deliver benefits to businesses, employers, home loan borrowers and consumers," he said in a statement.
The Reserve Bank on Wednesday cut official rates 0.5 percentage points to 5.0 percent, the fifth such cut in a year.
Brindley also urged more openness from the Reserve Bank to signal its intentions on future rates movements.

"Importantly, the governor of the Reserve Bank, Mr (Ian) Macfarlane, should consider more frequent opportunities to address economic issues to balance the political rhetoric which otherwise dominates media commentary," he said.
